candidates.name: IGAT 5 Gas Pipeline
candidates.from: South Pars Gas Complex, Jam, Bushehr
candidates.to: Aghajari Gas Injection Compression Station, Behbahan, Khuzestan

evidence.note: Lists IGAT-5 as one of the operating IGAT trunklines: 56 inch (1,420 mm) diameter, transfers sour gas from South Pars phases 6, 7 and 8 to Khuzestan Province for oil-well injection. States ten trunklines in operation and one (IGAT-11) under construction.

GIS dataset product page: 504 km, 56 inch IGAT-5 runs from South Pars Gas Complex in Jam, Bushehr, to the Aghajari Gas Injection Compression Station in Behbahan, Khuzestan; traverses Bushehr and Khuzestan provinces.

candidates.why_maybe_new: GEM roster contains IGAT 1,2,3,4,6,7,8,9,10,11 (P3957, P0442, P0443, P0444, P0445, P0446/P2015, P0447, P0448/P0457, P0440, P0441) but NO IGAT 5 entry. Distinct route (South Pars/Jam -> Aghajari-Behbahan, Khuzestan) and function (sour-gas injection) not matched by any existing roster row; the Asaluyeh-origin IGAT 6/7/8 lines go elsewhere. No plausible PID collision found.
